story_outline: 音乐 MV，弱剧情、强情绪。男孩进入夜市，看见女孩；两人隔着灯泡、烟、雨布、塑料凳和机车灯反复错身；他们穿过小巷、KTV 门口、修车铺、批发市场，最后到县城外田野小路，清晨前女孩消失，男孩停在路边。
style_notes: 1990s Hong Kong romantic neon cinema mood translated into explicit visual language: county-town objects, rain-wet reflections, cheap LED, red/green/amber/cyan fluorescent spill, smoke, plastic rain curtains, shallow depth of field, telephoto compression, off-center framing, no readable signage, no luxury cyberpunk.

A quiet boy rides a used street motorcycle into frame from the lower left, the headlight stretching into a long reflection on the wet road; in the distance, the girl is only a half-clear back view under the tarp lights. Telephoto compression, shallow depth of field, transparent plastic rain curtain and water droplets in the foreground, slow-shutter motion blur, romantic summer-night ambiguity, like a dream just beginning. All signage is unreadable colored blocks.
Negative: no glossy international metropolis skyline, no luxury sci-fi vehicle, no clean laboratory futurism, no readable Chinese shop signs, no real brands, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no celebrity likeness, no anime face, no heavy crowd, no fake cyberpunk skyscraper background.
